combo_label: Fruit & Veg × Maps & Navigation × The Canterbury Tales

entries.clue: Forked-beard trader in a beaver hat, talking profits while secretly in debt
Newcastle and Durham's corner of England, facing a cold sea
Zodiac sign the young sun is halfway through as the poem opens
Seedless stocking-filler citrus that all but undresses itself
Flemish mapmaker whose famous projection fattens Greenland
Crunchy taproot dangled before donkeys and given to snowmen for a nose
Prized green spears bundled up for a fleeting spring season
Bought from an apothecary to kill rats; two of three bottles get it
Big book of the world that lived in the car's door pocket
Chitted on an egg tray in a cold shed; a tattie by another name
Tilt with lances; the young attendant could do it, and dance, and write
One nautical mile per hour on the ship's log
